videos.title: Rocket Singh - Salesman Of The Year
videos.description: Harpreet, a fresh graduate, enters sales but struggles with its demands. He seeks balance between career expectations and his values. A crazy idea flips his world and makes his career successful.

videos.title: Kaagaz 2
videos.description: The Struggles of a common man whose right to life is infringed upon by protests and rallies.

videos.title: Hum Kisi Se Kum Nahin
videos.description: Munna Bhai, a gangster, loves Komal. He wants to marry her, but faces problems. Komal's brother and her boyfriend try to stop him, leading to funny events.

videos.title: Badrinath Ki Dulhaniya
videos.description: Badrinath wants a traditional wife, while Vaidehi seeks freedom. To break free from norms, they must redefine their roles together. Their journey is about challenging traditions.

videos.title: Jab We Met
videos.description: A heartbroken man meets a spirited girl on a train journey that changes both their lives. Their evolving bond of friendship and love makes this one of Bollywood's most beloved romances.

videos.title: Khatta Meetha
videos.description: Sachin Tichkule is an ambitious contractor who faces opposition from everyone, both at home and at work. But he continues to struggle.

videos.title: Darr
videos.description: An obsessed lover stalks a married woman, turning her life into a nightmare. His dangerous obsession blurs the line between love and madness in this psychological thriller of fear and passion.

videos.title: Naa Saami Ranga
videos.description: Famed across his village for sheer power and raw brutality, a fierce man becomes the primary mark for ruthless antisocial forces plotting to crush him under their violent agendas.

videos.title: Pyaar Tune Kya Kiya
videos.description: Ria falls in love with Jai, a photographer, who is already married to Geeta. But Ria is determined to force Jai to accept her - by hook or by crook.

videos.title: Luka Chupi
videos.description: Guddu, a reporter in a local news channel, falls in love with Rashmi and asks her to marry him. However, things turn chaotic when they begin a live-in relationship and their family knows about it.

videos.title: Kal Ho Naa Ho
videos.description: Naina's dull life changes when Aman arrives. She loves him, but he claims to be married and urges her friend Rohit to win her heart instead, leading to unexpected emotions and choices.

videos.title: Partner
videos.description: Prem, a love guru who shares tips on dating women, helps his client, Bhaskar, woo his boss. However, he later falls for a single mother and tries to hide his profession.

videos.title: Queen
videos.description: Rani, a Delhi girl ditched before her wedding, travels solo for her honeymoon, discovers new experiences, meets diverse people, and ultimately finds her own identity.

videos.title: War 2
videos.description: Working as a mercenary, Kabir accepts a high-risk mission for a criminal network. But soon, his task pits him against his unflinching former ally.

videos.title: Agneepath
videos.description: Vijay seeks revenge on Kancha, the man who destroyed his family, and rises from the streets to power. His journey of vengeance, sacrifice, and redemption forms a fiery saga of justice and honor.

videos.title: Dear Dad
videos.description: A teenage boy's road trip with his father turns into a journey of truth when the dad reveals he's gay. Their emotional conversations redefine love, acceptance, and the strength of family bonds.

videos.title: Beta
videos.description: Raju is the only child of a widowed multimillionaire. Raju's father can provide him anything he wants, but Raju's only desire is his mother's love.

videos.title: Action Replayy
videos.description: Fed-up with his parents constantly fighting, a young boy goes back in time to make his parents fall in love. This leads to hilarious situations.

videos.title: Dum Laga Ke Haisha
videos.description: A hesitant groom married to an overweight bride learns to embrace love beyond appearances. Their emotional journey captures small-town life, self-acceptance, and unexpected companionship.

videos.title: Chandni
videos.description: Chandni's fiance, Rohit, is paralysed in an accident and she is forced to relocate to Mumbai where her boss, Lalit, falls for her. However, she faces a dilemma when Rohit returns and woos her too.

videos.title: Badhaai Ho
videos.description: A 25-year-old man tries to suppress his embarrassment when his mother announces that she is pregnant.

videos.title: War
videos.description: Kabir, a secret agent, goes rogue after a mission to catch a terrorist goes awry. However, his boss sends Khalid, another agent and his student, to track him down.
